title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
description:
arXiv:2611.08577v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment
